title: ID0378405-DC/Si-D/DE[R3ML78] - Missing Converters in DC3/4
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Converters are found (230V are supplied) but Fastshutdown is not possible
Root cause:
KF214 is faulty → 12V coming from the output when it should only come when it's in Emergency
Solution:
Replace KF214
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
